prompt:
Build a 60 s closed-loop fixed-wing flight model in Simulink. Read xaero02_input from the MATLAB base workspace. The plant must implement nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body motion with aerodynamic forces and moments, propulsion, gravity, and dynamic control actuators. A waypoint manager and feedback controller must steer the aircraft through the four supplied three-dimensional waypoints while maintaining bounded airspeed, body rates, and tracking error. Vehicle motion must arise from the connected controller, actuator, propulsion, aerodynamic, and rigid-body paths; prescribed motion or replayed state histories are not valid.

Use xaero02_input.waypoints_m as the active mission, apply xaero02_input.crosswind_step_mps as a lateral wind step at 3 s, and initialize the forward airspeed from xaero02_input.initial_airspeed_mps.

The xaero02_input struct contains waypoints_m as a finite real 3-by-4 matrix whose columns are successive [x;y;z] waypoint positions in metres, crosswind_step_mps as a finite real scalar in [-6, 6] m/s, and initial_airspeed_mps as a finite real scalar in [12, 18] m/s. The controller must reject both signs of the stated crosswind range and remain effective across the stated initial-airspeed range. Waypoint, wind, and initial-condition changes must causally affect the connected flight and actuator dynamics.

Log complete-run Timeseries named flight_state, tracking_state, and actuator_state. flight_state has width 10 in this order: position x, y, and z (m); velocity x, y, and z (m/s); body rates p, q, and r (rad/s); and airspeed (m/s). tracking_state has width 7 in this order: reference position x, y, and z (m); tracking error x, y, and z (m); and active waypoint index (unitless). actuator_state has width 8 in this order: left-aileron, right-aileron, left-elevator, right-elevator, rudder, and horizontal-tail-trim deflection (rad); followed by left- and right-motor angular speed (rad/s). Every log must begin at 0 s, contain finite values on a strictly increasing time axis, and reach 60 s without truncation. The measured state, tracking error, waypoint index, and actuator states must come from the connected paths that determine aircraft motion. Save the completed model as cand_XAERO02.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO02.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
